title: An environment's committed settings, infra/env/<env>.json (#295)
description: The public choices for one environment, which infra/main.bicepparam and the environment scripts read. Every setting infra/main.bicepparam reads is listed here, and x-usnm-visibility says where it lives: public, in the committed file; private, in the settings store (an App Configuration store shared by the subscription's environments) under the environment's label, and never in the repository; local, in the environment's local settings file, written by the scripts. A setting left out takes its default in infra/main.bicepparam. Checked by scripts/lib/env_settings.py --check.

AZURE_ENV_NAME.description: Local: in the environment's local settings file. The environment's name, which the scripts set from --env.

AZURE_LOCATION.description: Local: in the environment's local settings file. The region, which scripts/azure/bootstrap.sh sets (see its --move).

USNM_ALERT_EMAILS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. Alert recipients' email addresses.

USNM_API_CERT_ID.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. A managed certificate's resource id, which names the subscription.

USNM_API_IMAGE_TAG.description: API-only ACR tag; when omitted, follows USNM_IMAGE_TAG.

USNM_API_MAX_REPLICAS.description: Maximum API replicas (default 2); divides the shared-searcher computation budget.

USNM_API_MIN_REPLICAS.description: Minimum Azure API replicas: production defaults to 1; 0 enables HTTP-triggered cold standby for both API and searcher (ADR-0029).

USNM_ARCHIVE_ACCOUNT.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The archival account's resource id, which names its subscription.

USNM_BOINC_CONTROLLER_ONPREM.description: Let USNM_BOINC_HANDOFF_RUNNER (CT 211) run the BOINC batch controller (#866): Reader on the subscription and a role that updates and starts the hand-off and bridge jobs.

USNM_BOINC_SERVER_ONPREM.description: The BOINC server runs on-prem (#942): skip the scan fetcher's reader grant on the BOINC Log Analytics workspace, which the on-prem server mode removes. Match "server" in contrib-compute/infra/boinc/env/<env>.json.

USNM_BOINC_HANDOFF_IMAGE.description: The BOINC hand-off job's image (#469): images.bridge from contrib-compute/infra/boinc/env/<env>.json. Empty or unset: no hand-off job.

USNM_BOINC_HANDOFF_ONPREM.description: Let USNM_BOINC_ONPREM_HOST run usnm-boinc claim and collect on-prem (#967 phase 3), with the hand-off job's grants: Cosmos ops, the ledger writer on curated, reader on reference, the node writer role on ocr-out, and Message Processor and Sender on the work queues. Pair it with USNM_COSMOS_ONPREM_ACCESS.

USNM_BOINC_ONPREM_HOST.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The on-prem BOINC host's own Arc machine identity's object id (usnm-boinc-arcs-<env>), with USNM_BOINC_HANDOFF_ONPREM.

USNM_BOINC_HANDOFF_RUNNER.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The scan fetcher's identity's object id (the scan-fetch container's Arc machine identity, #469), which pushes scans to boinc-handoff.

USNM_COMPUTE_CONCURRENCY.description: Visitor computation budget per searcher (default 2); shared searchers allocate floor(budget / API max replicas) to each API replica.

USNM_CONGRESS_MANUAL.description: Opt in to indexing manually downloaded Annals and Register volumes after an operator verifies OCR and provenance. Requires USNM_CONGRESS.

USNM_COSMOS_ONPREM_ACCESS.description: Open Cosmos DB to USNM_OCR_NODE_IPS (#967): public network access behind an IP firewall that allows those addresses only; the private endpoint stays and local auth stays off. No effect without USNM_OCR_NODE_IPS.

USNM_DATA_PRIVATE_ENDPOINTS.description: Private endpoints for the data lake, the index account and Cosmos. Default true. False: service endpoints and firewall rules for snet-cae instead (ADR-0008, amendment of November 2026).

USNM_EXPERIMENT.description: Local: in the environment's local settings file. dev's current experiment (an issue number), which scripts/azure/stand-up.sh sets and scripts/azure/teardown.sh clears.

USNM_EXPERIMENT_STARTED.description: Local: in the environment's local settings file. When dev's experiment started, which every provision of dev sets.

USNM_GITHUB_REPO_IDS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The repository's owner and repository ids, which the CI identity's federated credentials trust.

USNM_IMAGE_TAG.description: Local: in the environment's local settings file. The image tag dev runs, which scripts/azure/stand-up.sh sets to the commit it builds; elsewhere the default (main).

USNM_INDEX_ACCESS_TIER.description: The index account's default access tier. Default Hot. See docs/operations/search-serving.md, The Azure cold spare.

USNM_INDEX_STORAGE.description: Stage rebuilds in the separate Quickwit account. Default false; keep on once created.

USNM_INDEX_STORAGE_SERVE.description: Switch the searcher to the separate account during the documented cutover. Requires USNM_INDEX_STORAGE.

USNM_JA_OCR_ALERTS.description: Alert on supervised on-prem Japanese OCR failures (#1164) through the existing action group, independent of ingest jobs. Requires USNM_JA_OCR_ONPREM and alert emails. Install and verify the Entra-authenticated native supervisor before enabling.

USNM_JA_OCR_EXPECT_ACTIVE.description: Explicitly arm the Japanese OCR freshness alert while an active run is expected. Disarm during intentional idle, completion or a documented source-rate hold; never infer expectation from old activity.

USNM_JA_OCR_ONPREM.description: Run the Japanese OCR on-prem (#917): grants for the on-prem hosts' group and the data lake open to the node IPs. Pair with USNM_JA_OCR_JOB false.

USNM_LAKE_BLOB_SOFT_DELETE_DAYS.description: Default 3; restore 14 only after pruning the old lake index.

USNM_OCR_KEYVAULT_ADMINS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. Entra object ids given Key Vault Secrets Officer on the OCR nodes' vault.

USNM_OCR_LOCAL_COPY.description: Copy curated/ocr-local/ to a dataset on tank each day. The grant goes to USNM_SEARCH_LOG_COPY_HOST.

USNM_SCAN_ARCHIVE_UPLOADER_ID.description: Private: scan-host Arc principal granted only archive writer access.

USNM_SCAN_FETCH_PUBLISH_FETCHED.description: Let USNM_BOINC_HANDOFF_RUNNER (the scan fetcher, pve-big CT 211) publish its fetched-scans list (#1056): the node writer role on ocr-out (list, read, create; no delete), for usnm-ocr-worker publish-fetched.

USNM_OCR_DAMAGE_ONPREM.description: Let USNM_OCR_DAMAGE_RUNNER (an on-prem host's own Arc machine identity, pve-laptop CT 215) write the OCR damage tables (#296, usnm-ingest ocr-damage): create new blobs under curated/audit/damage/ only, with no read, overwrite or delete. It reads curated and reference through the on-prem hosts' group, so pair it with USNM_JA_OCR_ONPREM.

USNM_OCR_SYNC_ONPREM.description: Run the OCR pickup (usnm-ingest ocr-sync, ocr-seed, ocr-enqueue, ocr-requeue) on-prem as USNM_BATCH_HOST, pve-laptop CT 215 (#917): the lake role on curated (writes under ocr-local/ only), reference (status/ocr-local.json only) and ocr-requests, the exchange role on ocr-out and ocr-quarantine, its queue roles, Cosmos ops, Monitoring Metrics Publisher and AcrPull. Needs USNM_OCR_NODES; pair with USNM_OCR_SYNC_CRON manual.

USNM_INGEST_ONPREM.description: Let USNM_BATCH_HOST (pve-laptop CT 215) run usnm-ingest import-staged-run --current (#917): Cosmos Data Contributor on index_runs beside USNM_OCR_SYNC_ONPREM's ops. Needs USNM_OCR_SYNC_ONPREM.

USNM_BACKFILL_ONPREM.description: Let USNM_BATCH_HOST run backfill curation (usnm-ingest curate --enqueue, enqueue; #917): create under curated/pages/, Cosmos Data Contributor on batches and issues. Needs USNM_OCR_SYNC_ONPREM. Off until a backfill is needed.

USNM_OCR_SYNC_ALERTS.description: Alert on the on-prem OCR pickup (#1139): a failed ocr-sync run, no run through the pickup for more than 2 hours, and node output left in ocr-out over 72 hours (usnm-ocrs-failed-alert-<env>, usnm-ocrs-stale-alert-<env>, usnm-ocrs-backlog-alert-<env>), from the metrics it sends to the environment's Application Insights. With USNM_OCR_SYNC_ONPREM and alert emails.

USNM_BATCH_HOST.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The object id of the batch container's own Arc machine identity (usnm-batch-arcs-<env>, pve-laptop CT 215), with USNM_OCR_SYNC_ONPREM.

USNM_OCR_DAMAGE_RUNNER.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The OCR damage tables' writer's object id (an on-prem host's own Arc machine identity, usnm-batch-arcs-<env>), with USNM_OCR_DAMAGE_ONPREM.

USNM_OCR_NODE_GROUP.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The OCR nodes' Entra group's object id.

USNM_ONPREM_GROUP.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The object id of usnm-onprem-grp-<env>, every on-prem host's Arc identity (scripts/ocr-node/group.sh --kind onprem); it gets the roles any host needs for local work.

USNM_OCR_NODE_IPS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The OCR nodes' public IP addresses (the operator's home IP).

USNM_OCR_USERS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. Entra principals given access to Document Intelligence.

USNM_ONPREM_RELEASE_HOST.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The on-prem release container's Arc machine identity's object id (usnm-release-arcs-<env>).

USNM_ONPREM_SERVING_HOST.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The on-prem serving container's Arc machine identity's object id (#955).

USNM_SCHEDULED_INGEST_IMAGE_TAG.description: Primary ingest job ACR tag only; when omitted, follows USNM_IMAGE_TAG. Does not override backfill, sync or other ingest-image jobs.

USNM_SEARCH_LOG_COPY_HOST.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The search log copy host's Arc machine identity's object id (#1097).

USNM_SEARCH_LOG_READERS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. Entra principals that may read the search log.

USNM_SERIALSET_RUNNER.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The on-prem Serial Set runner's identity's object id (an OCR node's Arc machine identity).

USNM_SITE_CERT_ID.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. A managed certificate's resource id, which names the subscription.

USNM_VNET_ADDRESS_PREFIX.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The VNet's address space, an RFC 1918 block (no private addresses in the repository, #399).

USNM_WRITER_INGEST.description: The Quickwit writer's ingest API: v2 (Quickwit's default, at least once) or v1 (each accepted page once; the release restarts the writer for its final merges). docs/operations/rebuild-and-index-storage.md, "Duplicate-safe ingest" (#283).

USNM_WWW_CERT_ID.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. A managed certificate's resource id, which names the subscription.
